external_blocker.description: Parent independently verified an external 400-thread factor task covering 20150105 through 20261023. No external task was modified or stopped.

benchmark_scope.first_stage: One run per setting only for screening, not a stable performance claim

planned_commands.comparison: This establishes the numerical all/off reference.

conditional_fourth.condition: Only if the preceding results justify testing the combination. Do not continue a parameter sweep when improvement is absent or minor.

gates: Start only when load1<=50; benchmark enforces it both before import and immediately before the call.
No concurrent task-owned performance calculation or library rebuild; verify requested module SHA.
Independent observer records load every 10 seconds; any sampled value>100 marks performance invalid.
Compare each candidate with all/off: stock order, names/order, shape, NaN positions, and defined f32 bit patterns.
Never overwrite existing output tags. Failed or invalid runs need a new tag before retry.
A one-run improvement is screening evidence only. At least three admissible repetitions and first-run/min/median accounting are needed before a stable speed claim.
script_changes: Added --share-rho on/off and explicit environment reset; all A/B settings use 50 Rayon threads.
Added --expected-module-sha256 and recorded module SHA, GPT source hashes/mtimes, library path and mtime.
Added a lightweight separate load observer because the extension may hold the Python GIL; the observer creates no factor worker thread.
Recorded load samples/max and performance-validity flag; numeric outputs are still saved if performance is invalid.
Enforced 5107 stocks on 20241231 and all 491 GPT columns; preserved exact whole-output comparison and max differences.

Default and planned commands now import frozen candidate3 package; changed source hashes are verified against candidate3_sources.json, unchanged sources resolve to frozen/src, and backup mtimes are not used for consistency checks.

script_validation.note: Per parent request only scripts and pending-plan metadata were edited; no calculation, standalone Rust test, library build, or performance benchmark ran.

recommendation: Keep both scheduling and shared-input changes opt-in for now. Three-day equality supports numerical safety, but no admissible scheduling/sharing A/B timing has been run, so do not enable them by default or claim a speed benefit yet.

artifact_provenance.selection_rule: Files listed in candidate3_sources.json come from frozen/candidate3_src/<path>; other GPT files come from frozen/<path>. Changed sources must match saved SHA256.
artifact_provenance.current_sandbox_role: candidate2 delivery snapshot; experiment scripts never import its package or inspect its current src
